findings.title: Admission scanner work-budget enforcement before child queue allocation

Protected container, dict, dataclass, and string chunk traversals with exact remaining budget pre-reservation, charging 1 fixed refusal-accounting unit on refused reservations. Confirmed zero queue explosion (max_queue <= 6) across source, direct installed wheel, and sdist-derived installed wheel cohorts.
